div.head: Iud Dei IX Inscr.
div.ab: Benedictio ferri ab episcopo dánda. Ch (Ordinatio ad ferrum. Rj)
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 416 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page); Liebermann’s heading: [IX.]; F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date at the head of the text); Wormald, Making of English Law I; Whitelock, English Historical Documents I, October 2026 (was “c. 850–c. 975 (Liebermann)”, now “c. 850–c. 975 (Liebermann, I p. 416)”)

note.seg: Obwohl ein Priester sonst genügt, fordert dieser Text (in Rj vor c. 3) den Bischof; St. Wandrille braucht um 1082 den Diöcesan zur Einsegnung des ferrum; vgl. Du Cange Gloss. med. Latin. s. v. ferrum.

Although a priest otherwise suffices, this text (in Rj before c. 3) requires the bishop; St Wandrille c. 1082 requires the diocesan for the blessing of the ferrum; cf. Du Cange Gloss. med. Latin. s. v. ferrum.

div.ab: Blessing of the iron, to be given by a bishop. Ch (Ordinance for the iron. Rj)
